input_components.body28: Exactly 28 finite values: ECON canonical A-pose height, ECON beta[0:10], CameraHMR canonical A-pose height, CameraHMR beta[0:16].
input_components.face_ratios: Six ratios in feature order 29–34; use null when unavailable. Missing ratios are imputed using the frozen training medians in config/frozen35_coefficients.json; feature 35 is set to 0.
input_components.missing_body_features: Not imputed. The image pipeline records a front-end failure.

units: Heights in the feature vector remain in their respective model units. Beta values are model coefficients; face features are dimensionless. The regression output is centimeters.
